experimental_method: Sapphire-tube apparatus with water column over liquid CO2 and a mercury column; volume change of the CO2 and water columns read on a scale after 24 h at set T and p gives CO2 solubility and solution density.
uncertainties_stated: T +-0.2 K (bath); p +-0.01 MPa; overall uncertainty 1.55 per cent for solubility and 1.87 per cent for density.
quality_remarks: Hydrate film at the interface at T <= 283 K, authors judge its effect negligible; no stirring; mercury solubility neglected. Authors' maximum deviation of prediction from measurement stated as -6.02 per cent in abstract and -6.1 per cent in text.
not_extracted_tables: Table 3 (p. 1307): comparison of predictions of the authors' correlation with literature (Ref. 8) at 285 and 298 K and 5-40 MPa; derived/model values, not measurements

extraction_notes: Text layer matched the page image in every cell (both tables viewed). Sanity: x and density increase with p at each T, x decreases with T at fixed p. Journal page of Table 2 is 1306 (PDF page 6); Table 1 on 1305 (PDF page 5).
